essence: Both states, knowing: middle — reality shines forth.
All-body fancy: undivided mind, supreme rise.
Two winds clashing: evenness-knowing rises, yogin vessel.
Own bliss-filled world remembered: own nectar, supreme bliss.
Application manifests great bliss — reality shines through.
Bound channels, up-breath: happiness spreads at ant's pace.
Mind happiness-cast between fire-poison: yoked by memory-bliss.
Only brahman-reality's happiness, self-told, is told.
Licking, churning, pounding memory: power-absent bliss-flood.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
rasa.justification: The bliss and wind-blocks peak in intensity — clashing winds, nectar, sweet-taste, bliss-flood — yet each is staged as meditative placement (cast, remembered, yoked): wonder the practitioner wields rather than suffers.

sections.SUMMARY: The bliss-block: both states abandoned for the middle where reality shines; restrained consciousness expanding exceedingly; all-body fancy raising supreme rise through undivided mind; the two winds meeting where evenness-knowing makes the yogin into vessel; whole worlds remembered filled with own bliss and nectar; application manifesting great bliss through which reality shines; channels bound so happiness spreads at the ant's slow pace; mind cast happiness-made between fire and poison, yoked by memory-bliss; and the tongue-practices — licking, churning, pounding — carrying memory to bliss-flood even when power is absent.
sections.FUNCTION: Peak-intensity block: bliss as method, sensation as door, memory as the bridge to flood.
sections.KEY TERMS: samādhi (middle-resort as both states left); svānanda/svāmṛta (own bliss and nectar); bharitā-avasthā (filled state); jihvā-dhvani (tongue-practice names); manas-tarpaṇa (memory as yoking).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Bliss-flood flows into the joy-dissolving songs (p08); vessel imagery continues from p05.
sections.BOUNDARY: The taste-practices remain nameless-situated (woman-bliss, mouth) — carried literally, never moralized or bowdlerized (Roche note in lore).
sections.EXPLANATION: Where p03-p06 were anatomy, this is affect: the middle-reality reached by leaving both poles; consciousness so restrained it expands; the yogin made into a vessel at the wind-clash; whole worlds remembered as one's own bliss, own nectar; application—practice—turning technique into manifest great bliss that shines reality through; breath channeled until happiness crawls out at the ant's pace; mind placed between fire and poison and yoked by remembering sweetness; and finally the body's tastes — licking, churning, pounding — becoming doors even when the power itself is absent, so that memory alone floods.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh: vv68-69 powerful sexual experiences as access (his framing); Singh's lehana-note; v70's lehanā read literally per Roche.
